import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

out = Path("artifacts/hs0002-20260910")
roots = [out, Path("docs/engineering/evidence/hs0002-20260910")]
values = {key: os.environ.get(key) for key in ("SUPABASE_KEY", "SUPABASE_URL")}
files = [p for root in roots for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]
files.append(Path("docs/engineering/humansearch-hs0002-goal-2026-09-10.md"))
matches = {}
for path in files:
    data = path.read_bytes()
    present = [key for key, value in values.items() if value and value.encode() in data]
    if present:
        matches[str(path)] = present
result = {"checked_files": len(files), "variables_present": {k: bool(v) for k, v in values.items()},
          "matching_file_names_and_variable_names": matches, "values_printed": False}
print(json.dumps(result))
raise SystemExit(2 if not files or not all(values.values()) else 1 if matches else 0)
